<role>
You check one property (faithfulness) of a product-feedback opportunity for Keelwater, a claims-handling software company. You do not rewrite anything.
</role>
<definition>
Question: is every claim in the brief supported by the cited evidence and the fact sheet, with nothing overstated and no cited contrary evidence left out? Pass means yes.
Fail on an uncited claim, a number that is off the fact sheet, a scope wider than the cited accounts, a paraphrase placed in quotation marks, or an ignored contrary citation.
The evidence is the brief, the cited insights and the fact sheet (accounts, ARR, mentions, routes, renewals).
</definition>
<evidence>
{
 "brief": "## Problem\nThe Keelwater platform forces a single, universal claim routing approach. However, multiple commercial and specialty claims teams require a different, manual process to manage complex cases effectively, while other teams, such as motor claims, rely on and prefer automatic routing for efficiency and scalability. This one-size-fits-all system creates internal friction and forces workarounds [i:3ccee6c1b85c3e12] [i:49e903683f464d34].\n\n## Who is affected\n- **Commercial and specialty claims teams** who find automatic routing unhelpful and need manual control to manage complex files properly, especially with multiple suppliers and policyholders involved [i:49e903683f464d34].\n- **Motor claims teams** who prefer automatic claim allocation based on factors like postcode and workload to balance capacity and scale efficiently without adding headcount [i:63e7d0c8fea46281] [i:9bcfbf187a659dd5].\n- **Accounts managing multiple lines of business**, who report needing per-team configuration to satisfy both motor teams pushing for automation and commercial teams needing manual routing [i:c8869934e9e77aad] [i:ec07f5c294ac850c].\n\n## Evidence\n- This issue has been raised by 5 accounts across 6 total mentions [i:3ccee6c1b85c3e12] [i:49e903683f464d34] [i:63e7d0c8fea46281] [i:9bcfbf187a659dd5] [i:c8869934e9e77aad] [i:ec07f5c294ac850c].\n- Feedback has come via 2 distinct routes: 4 mentions during onboarding and 2 mentions via support [i:3ccee6c1b85c3e12] [i:49e903683f464d34].\n- The affected accounts represent a total ARR of 4480000.0 GBP [i:3ccee6c1b85c3e12] [i:49e903683f464d34] [i:63e7d0c8fea46281] [i:9bcfbf187a659dd5] [i:c8869934e9e77aad] [i:ec07f5c294ac850c].\n- Tidewell Marine & Cargo explicitly states that a one-size-fits-all approach does not work for them and that per-team configuration would solve the problem [i:3ccee6c1b85c3e12].\n- Marrowgate Commercial reports that their commercial and specialty claims handlers find auto-routing unhelpful and need manual routing for complex files [i:49e903683f464d34].\n- However, insights from the same and other accounts also show that motor teams strongly prefer automatic routing, with Marrowgate Commercial stating it is critical for scaling without adding headcount [i:9bcfbf187a659dd5].\n\n## Why now\n- The issue is actively impacting customer onboarding and ongoing support, with the most recent mention recorded on 2026-10-28 [i:c8869934e9e77aad].\n- One of the affected accounts, Marrowgate Commercial, has a renewal date of 2026-12-12 [i:49e903683f464d34].\n- In the last 90 days, 1 renewal has occurred [i:3ccee6c1b85c3e12] [i:49e903683f464d34] [i:63e7d0c8fea46281] [i:9bcfbf187a659dd5] [i:c8869934e9e77aad] [i:ec07f5c294ac850c].\n- The collective ARR of 4480000.0 GBP from the 5 vocal accounts is at stake, with renewal dates spanning from 2026-12-12 to 2027-07-31 [i:3ccee6c1b85c3e12] [i:49e903683f464d34] [i:63e7d0c8fea46281] [i:9bcfbf187a659dd5] [i:c8869934e9e77aad] [i:ec07f5c294ac850c].",
 "cited_insights": [

   "date": "2026-09-19T09:57:00+00:00",
   "id": "3ccee6c1b85c3e12",

<task>
Write a critique of 2-5 sentences naming the claim, quote or item you checked and what you found. Then give the verdict. If any single item fails, the verdict is fail.
</task>
<output>

response.content: {"critique": "I checked the Evidence section claim that 'motor teams strongly prefer automatic routing, with Marrowgate Commercial stating it is critical for scaling without adding headcount.' The cited insight [i:9bcfbf187a659dd5] is from Saltmarsh Specialty, not Marrowgate Commercial — the brief misattributes the quote. Other checks pass: 5 accounts, 6 mentions, 4 onboarding/2 support routes, ARR of 4,480,000 GBP, renewal span 2026-12-12 to 2027-07-31, and the most recent mention date 2026-10-28 all match the fact sheet and cited insights. However, the misattribution is an unsupported claim about which account said what.", "verdict": "fail"}
